explanation: Turin chocolatiers are said to have stretched scarce cocoa with local hazelnuts when Napoleon's blockade cut trade in the early 1800s. Nutella descends from the same paste.

claims.text: Gianduja is chocolate blended with ground hazelnuts.
Gianduja is not made with almonds, walnuts or pistachios.
Gianduja is said to have been developed in Turin in the early 1800s, when Napoleon's Continental System made cocoa scarce.
Nutella was developed from Piedmontese gianduja-style hazelnut pastes.
